answer: Harberger-taxed dune plot: one plot per identity, a 400-credit bond, a self-assessed price. The price sits under a cipher tag; each epoch costs 15% as tax. The ridge ledger is public: anyone may buy the plot at the posted price, evicting cheap squatters. A rented-tag ring fails both ways: cheap tags are bought out, dear tags bleed tax. 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 tax per epoch and lock 400,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 60 per epoch.
